description: This file defines the 'mbinfo' class in PHP, which reads and processes system monitoring data from a CSV file (MBM5.csv) for temperature, fan, and voltage information. It contains methods to parse the CSV data and return structured results related to hardware sensors.

classes.name: mbinfo
classes.description: A PHP class that reads MBM5 CSV logs to provide system sensor information such as temperature, fans, and voltage levels.

methods.name: temperature
methods.description: Reads temperature sensor data from CSV and returns labels, values, limits, and percentage usage.

methods.name: fans
methods.description: Reads fan speed data from CSV and returns labels, values, minimums, and divisors.

methods.name: voltage
methods.description: Reads voltage sensor data from CSV and returns labels, values, minimums, and maximums.
